releases.displayName: Let Them Come: Onslaught Demo Update and Release Date

items.text: A brand-new Let Them Come: Onslaught Demo update is live right now, and the full game launches November 11th!
[dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/2575650/Let_Them_Come_Onslaught_Demo/"]

This update brings major upgrades to gameplay variety, visual effects, and tracking your best runs. Whether you’re returning for another run or diving in for the first time, now’s the time to load up and blast through the alien horde.
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44357789/1fc8ccf895761da05177a0dadfeb39315be956d6.gif"]
Random Missions Experience new challenges every run with dynamically generated objectives
Mini-Boss Encounters Randomly appearing mini-bosses push your builds and skills to the limit
New Music Track A fresh new track joins the retro sci-fi soundtrack
Improved Visual Effects Refined many of the visual effects across the whole game
Rebalanced Weapons & Upgrades Combat feels smoother and more rewarding across the board
Stat Tracking Easily share your best scores and longest runs with your fellow survivors
Bug Fixes & General Polish – Various tweaks to performance and visuals.
Improved display of some languages
Added partial color vision correction support
The full Let Them Come: Onslaught experience arrives November 11th on Steam. Download the updated demo today and start perfecting your build for the incoming swarm!
You can also reach out to our team and chat with the Let Them Come community here on Steam forums or on our Discord server

items.text: We’re excited to introduce Update 4, our biggest patch yet, packed with new features and improvements we can’t wait for you to experience. Alongside a wide range of bug fixes and refinements, this update lays the groundwork for future content additions. Here's what we got:
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44357789/855b7ee158df37cf62ee444a04cefb4badbdd7b8.gif"]

Survive as long as you can against relentless, never-ending waves of enemies. Designed as the ultimate challenge for veteran players, this mode will push your skill, builds, and endurance to the limit.
Endless Mode was developed and balanced around a fully unlocked armory, so make sure you are fully equipped before diving in!
Unlock Requirement: Survive the final level on Normal Difficulty to unlock Endless on all levels.
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44357789/bd6a1083056ba5101a93c497cdd30326d17a1f95.gif"]
Exclusive to Endless Mode, the Online Leaderboard lets you compete against survivors worldwide, challenge your friends, and track your personal best escape times. Can you make it to the top?
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44357789/a6a740bf02b0f38ca9dd4635891204248667b402.gif"]
You already know the Frenzy Towers, giving a temporary boost to player stats when active.

But from now on, you can also discover Mutation Towers in your runs. To activate them, stand in the circle like you would for a Frenzy Tower and you will be able to choose one of 3 buffs. There are more than a dozen unique buffs available, each designed to give you the edge you need to keep fighting through the horde.
Note that the Mutation Towers have a higher chance to spawn in Endless Mode compared to the other modes.
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44357789/19c005bcb04d3cbfcc81401f90f37dd3e72725f5.gif"]
Weapon prototypes can now be upgraded beyond their original safety limits. Push them further than ever before to deal devastating damage and gain the power you need to survive the onslaught.
In order to access this feature, you must raise all 5 of your weapons to the Prototype mode in a run. This has to be achieved every time you want to raise your weapons beyond level 9.
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44357789/2c367dff9d847b94bd9d080a85f65c5d83d321b6.gif"]
Across all game modes, we’re introducing the Tech Kit. Purchase supplies before starting a run, and use them whenever you want to get out of a tough spot!
Use it wisely, the right supply at the right moment can secure a win, but a poorly timed decision might cost you the run.
Unlock Requirement: Survive the final level on Normal Difficulty to unlock the Tech Kit and Supplies menu in the Armory.
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44357789/c233d3c22e1e72eeee65ee23b41deb4a56356ca3.gif"]
To give you more control over your builds, we're introducing the Weapon Banish System.

Purchase Weapon Banish Chips in the Armory and use them on the level-up screen to remove unwanted weapons from your reward pool for the rest of the run. Each time you banish a weapon, the chip cost increases in this run, so choose wisely and shape your loadout with intention.
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44357789/34f3edc76e281c6db94b3a32f4b9421d2109b09e.gif"]

We have added two new tracks: "Final Rush" now plays during regular gameplay, bringing extra intensity to your runs, and a brand new theme plays during the fight against the Colossal Alien in the Alien Nest, making the final battle feel even more epic.
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44357789/4ceac3305a4bc26276b59a5442eacf1988d018ba.gif"]

notes.title: This is the list of changes with Hotfix 1

items.text: Added support for ultra-wide screen
Fixed boss not moving when taking lots of damage quickly
Added handling of keyboard locales
Added Master Volume setting
Fixed boss music resetting randomly during battle
Skipped shader compilation screen when booting the game multiple times
Fixed overlapping Super Shield cooldown
Fixed optimization issues related to FPS drop when opening the armory.
Fixed some armory upgrades descriptions.
Optimizations to visual effects.
Fixed Message Events appearing above the Level Up Screen.
Fixed HUD clipping with 5 weapons and weapon upgrades
Added language settings in the settings menu (WIP - Localization not integrated yet)
Fixed issue with Supply Drop SFX
Added impact visual effects for enemy projectiles
We have been paying close attention to the Feedback Survey results, and to the conversations on our Steam Forum and Discord page.
Here are the updates we made to the demo.
Reading players' feedback made us realize that we had too many "Manual Aiming" weapons in our current arsenal.
With this update, we are hoping to strike a better balance.
More weapons are now Auto-Aiming, and we are keeping one Manual Aiming weapon that expert players can still use if they want.
Let us know what you think of these changes!
Back when we launched the demo we didn't really have time to build a proper Options Menu.
It only allowed volume control and nothing else.
We are happy to announce that we now have a more fleshed out Options Menu!
This should allow you to adjust the game's settings to your liking, but it is still work in progress.
Please, feel free to let us know if you are encountering issues with this menu, or if you think some specific options are missing!
For those of you that have played the demo a lot already and want to experience this update with a fresh save file, we also added the option to delete your progress in the Settings Menu.
We also added lots of various improvements in this update.
New music track in the Armory (banger!)
Improved the visuals and sound of the lightning strikes in the level
Performance improvements: And many other small changes.
Now that this update is out, we will be focusing once again on creating new content for the game!
We can't wait to show you more as we get closer to our Early Access launch.
In the meantime, if you want to help us make this game as good as it can be, please keep sharing your feedback in the Feedback Survey or by making posts in the Steam Forum or our Discord.
